risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- MD&A flags sophisticated cyberattacks — ransomware, phishing, malware, DDoS, exploitation of software vulnerabilities, supply chain risks, insider threats and AI-powered attacks — as primary threats facing the IT industry the Company operates in, aimed at stealing data, disrupting systems and causing financial and reputational damage.
- The Company operates its business under one segment only, so segment-wise performance reporting was not applicable for FY2025-26, indicating no diversification across business lines.
- The Company is still in the process of stabilising, restructuring and rebuilding after emerging from the insolvency resolution process under the IBC roughly one and a half years ago, with performance yet to strengthen.
- MD&A states management 'shall review the existing risk management policy and lay down a defined risk management mechanism', indicating the risk mapping, exposure assessment and mitigation framework was not yet fully established as of the report.
- K B R Holdings Private Limited continued to be the Holding Company, holding 65.27% of the equity share capital, concentrating control in one shareholder.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- The Company is actively pursuing various business options to grow its operations, including identifying companies for acquisition or control to achieve inorganic growth, along with suitable funding options to support the same.
- Building up the organisation under the present management by recruiting experienced senior personnel and strengthening other departments.
